{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]

# Exclude QA orders from the dataset
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask]

# Check for refunded orders: they should not be included in conversion rate
completed_mask = sales_clean['status'] == 'completed'
sales_final = sales_clean[completed_mask]

# Final population size
final_population = len(sales_final)
print(f"Final population size: {final_population}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_rate = sales_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_rate)

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel
overall_conversion = sales_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nOverall conversion rate by channel:")
print(overall_conversion)

# Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment
segment_cross_tab = pd.crosstab(sales_final['channel'], sales_final['customer_segment'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(segment_cross_tab)

# Compute within-segment conversion rate differences (email - paid_search)
within_segment_diff = conversion_rate.groupby('customer_segment').apply(
    lambda x: x[x['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].iloc[0] - x[x['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].iloc[0]
).reset_index(name='diff')
print("\nWithin-segment conversion rate differences (email - paid_search):")
print(within_segment_diff)

# Extract the differences for each segment
email_loyal_cr = conversion_rate[(conversion_rate['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_rate['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]['converted'].iloc[0]
paid_search_loyal_cr = conversion_rate[(conversion_rate['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_rate['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]['converted'].iloc[0]
diff_loyal = email_loyal_cr - paid_search_loyal_cr

email_returning_cr = conversion_rate[(conversion_rate['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_rate['customer_segment'] == 'returning')]['converted'].iloc[0]
paid_search_returning_cr = conversion_rate[(conversion_rate['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_rate['customer_segment'] == 'returning')]['converted'].iloc[0]
diff_returning = email_returning_cr - paid_search_returning_cr

email_new_cr = conversion_rate[(conversion_rate['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_rate['customer_segment'] == 'new')]['converted'].iloc[0]
paid_search_new_cr = conversion_rate[(conversion_rate['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_rate['customer_segment'] == 'new')]['converted'].iloc[0]
diff_new = email_new_cr - paid_search_new_cr

print(f"\nQuantitative claims for verification:")
print(f"Final population size: {final_population}")
print(f"Conversion rate - email, loyal: {email_loyal_cr:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - paid_search, loyal: {paid_search_loyal_cr:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate difference (email - paid_search), loyal: {diff_loyal:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - email, returning: {email_returning_cr:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - paid_search, returning: {paid_search_returning_cr:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate difference (email - paid_search), returning: {diff_returning:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - email, new: {email_new_cr:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - paid_search, new: {paid_search_new_cr:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate difference (email - paid_search), new: {diff_new:.4f}")"}
